notes.title: Dealer's Life Legend Update #8 Is Out Now!
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings Dealers! Today is a big day for your business opportunities![/p][h1][b]Dealer's Life Legends Update #8 Is Out Now![/b][/h1][p]Enjoy the new features coming with version 0.801! They’ll enrich not only your negotiating experience but will also test your abilities! That's right, we have added a local leaderboard and game scoring to assess your skills throughout your quest to become the richest dealer in the Kingdom!

[/p][p]Read the full update notes here:[/p][p][/p][p]💎 [b]Improved controller support[/b]: We added more buttons to manage the diary (LT) and city details (RT) from any UI that shows them. The old buttons (back and start) are still working and can still be used, but from now on, the UI showing the keybind shortcuts will only show RT and LT.[/p][p]* [b]Auto save after events[/b], to avoid cheating by reloading the game after a bad event or a bad choice taken[/p][p]* [b]Game scoring and leaderboard[/b]: At the end of every game, just after the ending animation, a score will be assigned and recorded on a local leaderboard. Game score is influenced by the player's total assets value (the more the better), how many days it took to meet the Emperor (the less the better), and the difficulty chosen (harder difficulties will grant different magnitude orders of score)[/p][p]💎[b] Hirable Companions boost[/b]: With this update, we will grant 1 more Companion slot to every caravan's living quarters upgrade. From now on, every new game will still start with 1 available Companion slot, but the first upgrade will grant 2 more, and the maximum number of slots reachable in the game will be 6. If a player is in the middle of a game and he has already bought a living quarter update, one more companion slot will be granted for free[/p][p]💎 [b]Item zoom pop-up[/b]: We added the ability to see a bigger image of the buying/selling item during any negotiation (by selecting the smaller item's image in the trade details UI) and in the item inventory section of the diary (by selecting the new dedicated button in the item’s details section)[/p][p]💎 [b]Prestige balance for negotiations[/b]: Previously, it was only possible to gain +1 Prestige (if the customer never became angry) or no Prestige (if the customer became angry at least once). From now on, the player will be able to win or lose different amounts of Prestige, depending on their level of compliance with the customer. If the customer gets angry, it won't be good for business![/p][p]💎 [b]Various little QoL interventions[/b], including some more colored text to add detail and visibility, and a counter in Item Catalogue showing the amount of unlocked items and total items present in the game."[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186097/36e80d14c9a5e8310a4ef42769dc9fe56b4e40e5.png"][/img][/p][p]While these changes may seem smaller compared to the usual, this time we decided to focus on the foundation of what is going to be included in our next update, which will be one of the biggest in Dealer’s Life Legends' history! 
Your feedback will come in clutch to let the team know how to tweak further features to provide you with a fresh experience with the next patch, coming very soon![/p][p]

Follow us on our socials and let your friends know about Dealer’s Life Legends. Your wishlists, positive reviews, or just sharing the game with your communities are a huge support for our project![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186097/e99379f7443e9347830fbfafb15af48046bf9a01.png"][/img][/p][p]Your friendly indie devs,[/p][p]Abyte Entertainment[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186097/b964f06b511f3e079113b10cfd960bdde21bac2f.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Dealer’s Life Legend Update #07 - New Character visual details!
notes.notes:
Hello, Merchants!

We’re very excited to announce the release of [b]Update #07[/b]!

Pecunia is evolving! There are lots of new faces in the streets… and some familiar ones are looking a bit different. New hairstyles, new beard styles… has anyone else noticed a sudden rise in barber shops?

Jokes aside, here’s a complete list of the features that you’ll find in this update, which is out today!

💎 Community Feedback: We highlight improvements that are based on community feedback or suggestions. We look forward to your feedback in our Steam Community Hub or [url=https://discord.com/invite/7XPTJquhfF]Discord[/url] server.

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*]💎[b]Character Pack #2[/b]: we have introduced [b]36 new faces[/b], [b]36 new hairstyles[/b] (each with 4 color variants), and [b]21 new beards[/b] (also in 4 color variants). With all these additions, you’ll meet a much wider variety of characters and you’ll also be able to customize your own character like never before!
[*]💎[b]Difficulty Levels[/b]: when you start a new game, you can now choose between Easy, Normal and Hard modes to tailor the game to your preferred challenge level.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186097/1dd6c080edf5eb6252979e499e8f883030535228.png[/img]
[h3]Quality of Life[/h3]
[list]
[*]💎[b]Companions Skills balance[/b]: we’ve made significant improvements during generation and progression of Companion Skills. From now on, all Companions of the same level will always have the same number of Skills, while Mercenaries will consistently have one extra Skill compared to others. Because of this, now a Companion will automatically gain a new Skill when leveling up. If you have a game in progress, these improvements will take effect starting from the next Companion generation in the Tavern.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186097/e2e4cabb5991ef55f968c8ac950c3b86875ab24e.png[/img]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Allegiance balance in Town Events[/b]: if you knowingly acquire a cursed item during a Town Event, your Allegiance will now be affected accordingly.
[*][b]Prestige balance in Travel Events[/b]: we’ve increased the Prestige penalty for making evil choices during Travel Events. These actions now have a greater impact on your starting Prestige in the next settlement.
[*][b]Save game animation[/b]: we fixed an issue where the save animation would not display properly in certain situations.
[*]Other minor fixes and improvements.
[/list]
In addition to this, we’re delighted to announce that our official [b]Dealer’s Life Legend Avatars[/b] are now [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2185030/Avatar/List]available on Steam[/url]. We really hope you’ll like them and we look forward to seeing them in your profiles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186097/1c724dbcb561c3cd2c9ad31b80401302346d3174.png[/img]

That’s all for today’s update! Here’s the updated version of our Roadmap, we’re not that far from completing it! 🎉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186097/956eb54fff9bf8887f558f184167d1593ec1ad79.png[/img]
While releasing this update, we’ve also been hard at work behind the scenes on some other big features like the [b]Exchange Hall[/b], [b]Achievements[/b] and [b]new localizations[/b], and we’re making great progress! So stay tuned, there will soon be more news!
Talking about achievements, at one point they will show up in the coming weeks but you will not be able to unlock them yet. For testing purposes we unfortunately have to make them public before releasing them. So please keep that in mind when people start asking about why the achievements are not working in the Steam forums. 😅

As always, if you like the game, please consider writing a review, these can help a lot in spreading the word about Dealer's Life Legend! <3

Your friendly indie devs,
Abyte Entertainment
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186097/ec5822f68ec5af72ac069ba8c3fb5cd348247223.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186097/b964f06b511f3e079113b10cfd960bdde21bac2f.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Dealer’s Life Legend Update #06 - Town Events!
notes.notes:
Hello, Merchants!

We’re very excited to announce the release of [b]Update #06[/b], another major step forward in our journey to bring Dealer’s Life Legend to its 1.0 Release, merging our ideas and your precious feedback! 🎉

Big things are happening in Pecunia and all the towns are buzzing with activity! Be prepared, because anything can happen: from angry customers storming in, to unexpected opportunities and tricky offers that will test your judgment. Choose wisely and try to get the best outcome from every situation!

Here’s a complete list of the features that you’ll find in this update, which is out today!

💎 Community Feedback: We highlight improvements that are based on community feedback or suggestions. We look forward to your feedback in our Steam Community Hub or [url=https://discord.com/invite/7XPTJquhfF]Discord[/url] server.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186097/0792a8d7c41609d0413a575609450e6316ba13d2.png[/img]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] 💎[b]Town Events[/b]: we introduced nearly [b]60 new events[/b] that can happen while you’re in town! Just like travel events, town events come with new challenges, exciting opportunities and consequences. Make every decision count!
[*] 💎[b]Overview section in Bank[/b]: we made some changes in this building by replacing the “Work In Progress” tab dedicated to investments with the Overview tab, a new section where you can check all your assets and incoming expenses in a single place! What about investments, you ask? Well, we decided that the investment mechanic is too big to be relegated to a mere Bank section, that’s why we added the…
[*] [b]Exchange Hall[/b]: if you start a new game you’ll now notice a [b]brand new building[/b] (currently closed by the Work In Progress icon) where you will soon be able to manage your investments (or should we say stock trades? 🤑)! Stay tuned for more details soon! 
[*] [b]Item Pack[/b]: we added [b]126 new items[/b] to the list, from scepters to warhammers and chain mails! We’re now officially at [b]1000+ total items[/b]! 🎉
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186097/dc343af948688151ae8c327a306f18cfd2ba39f6.png[/img]
[h3]Quality of Life[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Gold and Prestige animations[/b]: we added some new nice animations to make Gold and Prestige value changes more visible and clear.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186097/6d6ee9f0b28473fa24a85aea2d5dc5534812b7ed.png[/img]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list][*] 💎 [b]Auctions and Arena fights now save the game[/b]: we added a save point right after every completed Auction and Arena fight.
[*] [b]Game Seed[/b]: we fixed some issues related to the random seed logic not working correctly.
[*] Other minor fixes and improvements.[/list]
That’s all for today’s update! It’s been another quite big update, we’re moving full speed ahead on our roadmap!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186097/16c678f298f59c4f240c5d67471add01a26cf214.png[/img]
We’re eager to know if you like all these improvements, so let us know what you think in the comments and join us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/7XPTJquhfF]Discord[/url] where you’ll find us hanging out and answering questions. And if you like the game, please consider writing a review, these can help a lot in spreading the word about Dealer's Life Legend! <3

Your friendly indie devs,
Abyte Entertainment
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186097/ec5822f68ec5af72ac069ba8c3fb5cd348247223.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186097/b964f06b511f3e079113b10cfd960bdde21bac2f.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Dealer’s Life Legend Update #05 - Time to Fight for Trophies!
notes.notes:
Hello, Merchants!

We’re thrilled to announce the release of [b]Update #05[/b], quite a big update! 🎉

All Arenas in the Empire are now opening their doors! Crowds are gathering from across the land to witness the thrill of epic gladiator combat! What are you waiting for? Come join the (fight) club!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186097/49864eadbcdc474cfca1e568a58de07548af5ee3.png[/img]
Here’s a complete list of the features that you’ll find in this update, which is out today!

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Arena[/b]: another brand-new building opens its doors! In the Arena you’ll be able to watch thrilling fights and guess the winner, or even send your own Companions into battle! In any case, glory and great prizes await!
[*] [b]Trophy Hall[/b]: located in the same “Extra” submenu of the Item Catalogue, the Trophy Hall is the place to relive the very best items you’ve encountered across all your games! From the most expensive items bought to the most profitable ones sold, every step of your personal Legend will be displayed here!
[*] [b]Item Pack[/b]: this update’s item pack contains [b]126 new items[/b], including spellbooks, rare antiques, and gorgeous paintings! We’re now very close to [b]1000 total items[/b]!
[*] [b]Customer Name Pack[/b]: we added [b]150 new male names[/b], [b]150 new female names[/b] and [b]150 new surnames[/b] to increase even more the variation of the generated names. All these new names and surnames will mix together with the old ones and create thousands of new and funny combinations!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186097/d878bc7a120f6a7564962d49f355a1b89887c56f.png[/img]
[h3]Quality Of Life[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Damage & Heal animations[/b]: we added nice animations to make damage and healing effects more visible and clear.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Item generation[/b]: we fixed a very sneaky bug in the early game Item generation that could lead to easy profit through very valuable Items on Auction. Now the Items on Auction are generated with the correct progression.
[*] [b]Intelligence balance[/b]: we slightly improved the Item estimation logic for more accurate evaluations based on Intelligence.
[*] [b]Prestige in Carpentry[/b]: Prestige now increases accordingly when upgrading multiple Caravan elements at once.
[*] [b]Controller navigation[/b]: Fixed a minor bug affecting controller navigation during negotiations.
[*] [b]Event effects[/b]: fixed some effects on Items that are now applied only on the correct available Items. (More event-related news coming soon... 😏)
[*] Other minor fixes and improvements.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186097/9c315b169589908e39237f18264e414cac9e1c62.png[/img]

Also, in case you missed the news, we’d like to remind you that Dealer’s Life Legend has recently been [b]approved for Steam Deck[/b]! If you have the possibility, we highly recommend trying the game there, we think it fits perfectly on a portable console! ❤️

That’s all for today’s update! We’re making great progress and we hope you’re enjoying every step of this journey with us. 🎉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186097/c1d01a7a52ae0b5ce844c3fc94196305279eb9e1.png[/img]
Let us know what you think in the comments and join us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/7XPTJquhfF]Discord[/url] where you’ll find us hanging out and answering questions. And if you like the game, please consider writing a review, these can help a lot in spreading the word about Dealer's Life Legend! <3

notes.title: Dealer’s Life Legend Update #04 - Art and Collecting
notes.notes:
Hello, Merchants!

We’re very proud to announce the release of the new [b]Update #04[/b]! 
Today is a monumental day in Pecunia! The Emperor has just declared that paintings are now tradable! A cultural revolution is underway, with master painters creating stunning portraits of legendary figures from ballads and epic tales. Geek alert: you might even recognize some familiar faces!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186097/7651df098d39a756bb88cf8a73ec1f6929d1b145.png[/img]

[list]

notes.title: Dealer’s Life Legend Update #03 - Quality Of Life and Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello, Merchants!

We’re pleased to announce the release of [b]the new Update #03![/b] This time we bring some juicy improvements aimed to polish the game flow, the world balance and the UI. ːdl2_diamondː
This update is a bit smaller than usual because we are working on some big new content behind the scenes, we are a very small team but we still wanted to introduce some community-inspired changes in the meantime, we really hope you’ll enjoy them!

Here’s a list of the features that you’ll find in the latest update, which is out today!

💎 Community Feedback: We highlight improvements that are based on community feedback or suggestions. We look forward to your feedback in our Steam Community Hub or [url=https://discord.com/invite/7XPTJquhfF]Discord[/url] server.

[h3]Quality of Life[/h3]
[list][*][b]Companion Hiring improved flow[/b]: the Diary’s Companions section now automatically opens when you hire a Companion to allow you to craft new potions right away!
[*][b]World generation balance[/b]: we improved the game world generation algorithm in order to guarantee more special buildings variation between cities at the same distance to the Capital (row). Your choices now differ a lot more in terms of special buildings when you have to choose where to travel next, which allows for different strategies and play styles. Please note that this improvement can only take place with a new world generation, so it’s not applied in your current game but it will be applied starting from your next game.
[*]💎 [b]Item’s rarity & condition colors[/b]: we added color coding for item rarity and item condition in order to let you recognize immediately these details.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186097/6c2d3946592ba8cf3fa9d0a56f95c2431d85e9ab.png[/img]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list][*]💎 [b]Quest flow[/b]: you can now see Quest details in the Tavern even if you don’t have a Companion.
[*]💎 [b]Quest success probability[/b]: we tweaked the Companion success dials in the Quest screen to better estimate Peril and Opportunity success rate. Now if you see a full green dial, you can be sure your Companion will succeed in every single check, without needing a potion! This also means that you should be really careful when you see yellow and red dials… or bring a lot of Potions for your Companion!
[*][b]Steam Deck resolution[/b]: we disabled the possibility to choose a windowed resolution in the options menu when playing on Steam Deck. The game works simply great on Steam Deck, you should try it out![/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186097/25d0322974528bc0c263a07107b12e53a6bc8634.png[/img]

That’s all for today’s update! ːdl2_luggageː

Let us know what you think in the comments and join us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/7XPTJquhfF]Discord[/url] where you’ll find us hanging out and answering questions. And if you like the game, [b]please consider writing a review[/b], these can help a lot in spreading the word about Dealer's Life Legend! <3

Your friendly indie devs,

notes.title: Dealer’s Life Legend Update #01 - Alchemic Tower & EA Roadmap!
notes.notes:
What a first week it has been! We wanted to say another THANK YOU to everyone who has played, recommended, and made content about Dealer’s Life Legend! It’s truly humbling for the whole team and has filled us with joy!

We’ve been getting a lot of feedback here on Steam and our [url=https://discord.com/invite/7XPTJquhfF]Discord[/url], and we’re incredibly grateful for it! This isn’t our first rodeo launching a game into early access, so we know we have a big job ahead and we’re incredibly thankful to have a community so full of ideas. 

Here are some features in the first content patch which has just dropped!

💎 Community Feedback: we highlight improvements that are based on community feedback or suggestions. We look forward to your feedback in our Steam Community Hub or [url=https://discord.com/invite/7XPTJquhfF]Discord[/url] server.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186097/f7416ee3328c7e069d569ca66edfbcec18e22ee2.png[/img]

[b]Features[/b]
[list][*] [b]Alchemic Tower[/b]: A new building that you may have spotted in the towns you visit is opening its doors! It will allow you to order potions without needing a companion to craft them.
[*] [b]Item Pack[/b]: We’re pleased to be adding so soon after the launch over 100 new items that you’ll be able to buy and sell with customers which take the total over 550 - including runic maps, glittered sandals and staffs of all kinds! [/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list][*] 💎 [b]Optimisation round #1[/b]: We fixed the 60fps lock that a Unity update had broken.
[*] 💎 [b]Chinese localization improvements[/b]: Minor fixes from our translator, let us know if you spot any other areas for improvements! [/list]
[b]Quality of Life[/b]
[list][*] 💎 [b]Quest improvements[/b]: Quest Difficulty is now shown before starting a quest, and quest generation is now dependent on your progress, which should make them more balanced as you go through your playthrough. 
[*] 💎 [b]Numpad Enter keybind[/b]: For all you numpad users, you can now use ‘Enter’ for keybinding. [/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186097/a4c0b0ddd557e0718bb216320d2175778565e4b8.png[/img]
[h2]Future Roadmap[/h2]

We also wanted to tease a few things we’re already working on based on your feedback that will be coming at a later (but not far away) date.

[b]The Arena[/b]: Send your companions to the arena and have them battle and earn rewards!

[b]City Events[/b]: Events will no longer only happen as you travel! They can pop up in towns and cities as well!

[b]Investments[/b]: Currently, you can take out a loan at the bank, but we also plan to have investments available where you can store your money and watch it (hopefully) grow!

[b]Customer & Item Packs[/b]: We’ll continue to add to the customer and character variation and provide brand-new items and gear to deal!

These will also accompany Steam Achievements, your Item Catalogue and Trophy Hall and a number of quality of life upgrades, like New Localisations (French, Russian and Italian) and New Difficulty Settings. We are always taking your feedback into account so there will be many of these quality of life updates based on what the community suggests! Thank you for your support - please keep having fun and sharing your feedback with us! 

We’re so excited to go on this journey together, and this update and roadmap is just the beginning. 

Your friendly indie devs, 
Abyte Entertainment

notes.title: Dealer’s Life Legend Launches Into Early Access!
notes.notes:
It’s been a long time coming for us as a team, and now we're so excited to bring you the latest and greatest installment in the Dealer’s Life series - [b]Dealer’s Life Legend[/b]! 

Until the 22nd of January, you’ll be able to pick up Dealer’s Life Legend with a 10% launch discount so hop aboard, the title of Pecunia’s finest merchant is yours to claim 👑 You can [url=https://discord.com/invite/7XPTJquhfF]join our community in Discord[/url] to get tips, show off your biggest deals, and give us feedback for Early Access, we’d love to hear your thoughts on how we can make this the best Dealer’s Life yet! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186097/7c1f2cb363298b6c9b6fa1f38f0da44c2ef783a3.png[/img]

[h2]Key Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]The world is your oyster! [/b]- Your caravan is your shop and can be customised to your liking. Gather relics, goods and oddities from across the empire, ensuring your shop is THE place to go. 
[*] [b]Haggle your way to the top[/b] - Fine-tune your haggling skills and charisma to sway customers and make bags of money. Visit the auction house, interact with customers and stock the hottest commodities. During your growth as a merchant you’ll come across quests that will allow you to gain unique items or add boons to your skills. 
[*] [b]Dabble in the mystics[/b] - Magical, cursed and forgotten objects may fall into your hands along the way. Use them alongside magical potions to your advantage. 
[*] [b]Make friends and enemies[/b] - Use your charm to navigate the factions and choose who you will ally with. Beware! Based on how you interact with other competitors who share your quest, you’ll forge lasting connections or build strong rivalries.
[/list]
We’ve already localised the game into a whole host of languages including Simplified Chinese, Korean, Turkish, Thai, German, and more. If you have a desire for more languages, let us know in [url=https://discord.com/invite/7XPTJquhfF]our Discord[/url], we’d love to hear from you! If you do enjoy the game, please leave a review, it makes a big difference!

notes.title: Demo available now until Early Access Launch!
notes.notes:
Hello merchants!

We know there’s a lot of excitement for the latest title in the Dealer’s Life series which is why we’re so excited to [b]release a new demo from today[/b] for you to get stuck into and start your journey as the greatest merchant these lands have ever seen! 

With [b]release on 15 January 2025[/b], we’re keen for you to be able to try the game before you buy, and get to grips with some of the changes we’ve made to the series. Don’t worry, you’ll be able to carry across your save from the demo to the full game, so any time you spend bartering and haggling over the next few weeks won’t go to waste. 

[previewyoutube=nTNFjAeSa00;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Demo content:[/h2]
[h3]Opening towns[/h3]
You’ll be able to explore 3 towns and villages as part of the Wandering Merchant Quest and trade, barter and hire companions to your heart’s content! This should give you a taste of the larger world you’ll get to explore.

[h3]Game Seeds[/h3]
We’re very excited for Dealer’s Life Legend to bring seeding to the game. Every game you play comes with its own unique seed. You’ll be able to share this seed with your friends and play the exact same game or if you’d like to try a more challenging seed, beginning to truly test yourself. The world, cities, items, customers, quests, and events will all match the given seed—allowing you to compete under identical conditions. The only thing that will set you apart is your strategy, decision-making, and deal-making skills. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186097/8361873d4b835ac696746183c424b20d66a68fd7.png[/img]

[h3]Quests & Companions[/h3]
The opening locations will feature a variety of companions who you can add to your party, or send out to complete quests for you. We’re really looking forward to hearing more about how you use this feature and we hope it adds to the player experience for Dealer’s Life Legend! 

[h3]Potions[/h3]
As part of the fantasy world of Dealer’s Life Legend, potions allow you to improve key skills and add an extra level of skill to the game that we think will really add to your trading experience. Let us know in Discord which potions you’re enjoying the most and/or struggling with as we continue to fine-tune balancing into Early Access! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186097/92e7c0e90811292e902cd3c52da7dd32c4969332.png[/img]

We’re really excited to be opening the doors to players ahead of our Early Access launch and want to hear your thoughts and suggestions for content to be added. Please join our Discord, take part in conversation and ask any questions you may have! 

In conclusion, thank you for all your support for the series and for all the love you’ve already shown. 

We can't wait to share this new journey with you. Stay tuned for more updates!

Your friendly indie devs,
Abyte Entertainment

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38835319/ec5822f68ec5af72ac069ba8c3fb5cd348247223.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38835319/b964f06b511f3e079113b10cfd960bdde21bac2f.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Dealer's Life Legend: Early Access
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186097/17ef17bfa8af2a0f5508574eb5b8b5098dd0987f.png[/img]

It is with great pleasure and honour for us to announce that Dealer’s Life Legends is going to launch in [b]Early Access on Steam 15th January 2025[/b]!

You heard it right, release time is just around the corner, so we encourage you to press that “Wishlist” button if you haven't already, this way you’ll be notified at the exact moment the game will be available! We also have a shiny new trailer for you to see what you can expect from Dealer’s Life Legend.

[previewyoutube=nTNFjAeSa00;full][insert trailer link][/previewyoutube]
[h2]FEATURES[/h2]
[h3]QUESTS & COMPANIONS[/h3]
Now let’s talk about a huge new feature: quests! Many folks in town need your help to overcome tons of missions. It’s too dangerous out there by yourself and you’re too important to risk your life, so this means that you’ll need to send Companions to embark on these perilous adventures! Whether your Companions will come back with their backpack full of treasures or beaten and wounded, is up to their Skills and your choices. Choose the best Companion to send on each quest, prepare yourself with a range of potions to turn the tides in your favour and cross your fingers for the outcome!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186097/08ad5184c2e3bb450f2d32a0a80b1b6cbd72b3b8.png[/img]
[h3]GAMEPLAY TUTORIAL[/h3]
We heard your feedback loud and clear and we developed a detailed in-game tutorial with a proper explanation for every game mechanic, this way you can undertake the Wandering Merchant Quest armed with knowledge and wisdom! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186097/42373066680f637935b65b1a614589e7cf8273d6.png[/img]
[h3]LOCALISATION[/h3]
Speaking of languages, we currently have 8 languages already included at the start of Early Access. If yours is still not listed on the Steam page, don’t worry, we are already planning to add more as we work towards full launch. Just send us a message on Dealer’s Life discord server to show your interest in that specific language.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43186097/22b49d8c1c61519e0362fa9c66fdaf66f6ae7e78.png[/img]
[h3]ADDITIONAL FEATURES[/h3]
There are a heap of new gameplay aspects that you haven’t got to experience which we are excited to share! This includes travelling from city to city with special events, the majestic Capital biome, the game ending, overall game balancing, bug fixing and lots more.

We’re far from developing everything we have in mind, and we already have lots of new features and improvements planned, but we think this is a great starting point to deliver Dealer’s Life into Early Access! We love hearing your feedback and are excited to build Dealer’s Life Legend with you all, as usual[url=https://discord.gg/DXuuj6v] join our Discord [/url]to stay up to date!

In conclusion, thank you for all your support and for all the love you showed to our game demo. We can't wait to share this journey with you.

Stay tuned for more updates!

Your friendly indie devs,
Abyte Entertainment
